checks.name: Repeated manual slicing retains UUIDs, moved names, local settings and one shared pixel source
Grid changes that remove live frames fail before any generated asset mutation
Nonfinite and oversized grids reject without allocating assets
A decoded parent replacement updates every linked frame without changing child identity or local pivot
Late parent replacement incompatible with a local crop retains the old image and all frames
Reimport of a derived frame refuses to overwrite shared ownership
Save/reload retains full source linkage, normalized geometry and independently authored settings
Malformed persisted derived geometry rejects before clearing the current asset database
Asset dependency closure follows a blank-source derived frame through its image owner
Imported trim offsets survive metadata save/load and materialize full original frame dimensions
Atlas frame reorder preserves IDs and parent-source geometry refresh uses stable frame keys
Missing atlas images refuse extraction without creating child records
Atlas extraction includes both metadata owner and image in package closure
Asset moves and missing-reference repair update complete derived metadata identities
Pixel subregion resolution uses source pixels once even when the source has an authored crop
Derived texture caching remains bounded and clears its accounting on project disposal
Serialized derived dimensions follow validated frame metadata and UUID references normalize case
Non-image derived metadata rejects before project mutation
Decoded image cache bounds pending ownership and disposes all retained work
Oversized texture rejection is actionable and a successful same-source reimport enables retry
Derived image diagnostics distinguish missing owners and out-of-bounds replacement images
Frame animation follows original atlas order and unequal durations through save/reload
Missing extracted frames refuse animation creation before adding any asset
Packed clockwise frames without sourceSize infer their unrotated dimensions
Transparent trim reads a blank-source linked frame and commits its local region
Pixel read refuses oversized sources before constructing a decoder
Pixel read rejects edits and project removal during decoding without changing crop
Pixel read exposes decode failure and cancellation without changing authored settings
